cutoffValidEvidenceMissedByDiscovery.source: 农业农村部畜牧兽医局
cutoffValidEvidenceMissedByDiscovery.claim: November 2018 monitored hog inventory was -0.7% MoM and -2.9% YoY; breeding-sow inventory was -1.3% MoM and -6.9% YoY.
cutoffValidEvidenceMissedByDiscovery.diagnosticMeaning: Breeding-sow inventory is a leading production-capacity state variable. A large YoY contraction can precede consumer pork-price inflation by biological production lags.

cutoffValidEvidenceMissedByDiscovery.claim: Additional ASF outbreaks continued to be confirmed in multiple provinces during mid-December.
cutoffValidEvidenceMissedByDiscovery.diagnosticMeaning: The supply shock was still propagating rather than clearly resolved at cutoff.

cutoffValidEvidenceMissedByDiscovery.claim: Additional ASF outbreaks were still being confirmed through late December, including in large farms/production regions.
cutoffValidEvidenceMissedByDiscovery.diagnosticMeaning: Persistent disease events reinforced the capacity-risk interpretation before the Dec 31 cutoff.

causalDiagnosis.observedError: Discovery treated weak current pork prices as the dominant physical confirmation test and did not freeze breeding-sow/hog inventory as separate leading state variables.
causalDiagnosis.whyPriceWasLagging: Accelerated slaughter can temporarily increase near-term supply and depress spot pork prices even while breeding capacity is being destroyed. The biological production cycle means capacity contraction can lead future finished-hog scarcity by months.
causalDiagnosis.implication: For supply shocks, discovery must identify the causal state variable that controls future supply rather than requiring contemporaneous output/spot-price confirmation.

genericRuleCandidate.name: state_variable_hierarchy_for_supply_shocks
genericRuleCandidate.scope: Generic across biological, commodity, industrial and capacity-constrained markets.
genericRuleCandidate.rule: When the hypothesis is a supply contraction, search separately for leading capacity/stock variables, current flow/output variables, and lagging spot-price/margin variables. Do not let a temporarily weak lagging price veto a verified collapse in productive capacity.
genericRuleCandidate.antiOverfit: Do not promote solely because a capacity variable falls. Selection still requires causal persistence, listed-company exposure, earnings conversion, expectation burden and downside tests.

versionImplication.reason: The relevant leading evidence never entered the frozen source pack, so downstream V1.5 selection logic could not evaluate it. Same-period outcomes cannot validate a new rule.
